description: Extract web, news, image, and autocomplete results from Baidu by keyword.

dateFrom.description: Start of a custom publication window (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides the time range. Web and news search only.
dateFrom.title: From date

dateTo.description: End of a custom publication window (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides the time range. Web and news search only.
dateTo.title: To date

exactPhrase.description: Require web results to contain this exact phrase (quoted automatically). Web search only.
exactPhrase.title: Exact phrase

excludeWords.description: Words to exclude from web results, one per line. Web search only.
excludeWords.title: Exclude words

fileType.description: Restrict web results to a file format using Baidu's filetype: operator. Web search only.
fileType.title: File type

includeSerpFeatures.description: Also return Baidu's answer box, knowledge panel, related searches and related videos as separate rows. Web search only.
includeSerpFeatures.title: Include SERP features

language.description: Restrict web results to pages written in Simplified or Traditional Chinese. Web search only.
language.title: Chinese script filter

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results per query. Practical Baidu ceilings: web about 100, news about 140, images about 1500.
maxResults.title: Max results per query

mode.description: Which Baidu surface to scrape: web results, news, images, or autocomplete suggestions.
enumTitles: Web search (organic results, related searches, SERP features)
News search (articles with source, date, summary and image)
Image search (original image URL, thumbnail, source page, dimensions)
Autocomplete (up to 10 query suggestions per keyword)
mode.title: Search mode

queries.description: One or more search terms. Each query is scraped independently up to maxResults.
queries.title: Search queries

siteRestrict.description: Limit web results to one website domain, e.g. wikipedia.org (site: operator). Web search only.
siteRestrict.title: Restrict to domain

sortBy.description: Order news results by relevance or by publication time. Applies to news search only.
sortBy.title: News sort order

timeRange.description: Restrict web results to a publication window. Applies to web search only; news has its own sort order.
timeRange.title: Time range

titleOnly.description: Match the query against page titles only (intitle: operator). Web search only.
titleOnly.title: Search titles only

title: Baidu Search Scraper Input
